item.title: Running
item.description: They asked for his time but not how he got there. Did he stumble? Did his body crumble like a soggy crepe held up by the sticks of his legs on his way to a determined mark on a map? Or did he bumble like a bee all grace no trace of a single step with every toe tasting loving the scent of asphalt?
